testcase.system-out: Scenario: Create and switch model states in an empty part ✔ Given a new empty part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the model browser shows the expanded Model State branch with Primary active ✔ When the user opens the Model State branch context menu ✔ Then it offers New Model State, Expand All Children and collapses All Children ✔ When the user opens the New Model State submenu ✔ Then it offers New Model State and Duplicate Primary ✔ When the user chooses New Model State ✔ Then a new model-state entry appears and is active ✔ And its generated name is selected for inline editing ✔ When the user enters a new state name and presses Enter ✔ Then the new name appears in the model-state row and branch label ✔ And the browser root and document tab identify the new state ✔ When the user double-clicks the Primary model-state entry ✔ Then Primary is marked as active ✔ And the browser root and document tab identify Primary ✔ When the user double-clicks the new model-state entry ✔ Then the new state is marked as active ✔ And the browser root and document tab identify the new state ✔ And the viewport remains empty
